svg.text: PERSON specialization — on PER_TYP, disjoint + total
CRASH_UNIT specialization — on unit_type, disjoint + total
OCCUPIES links OCCUPANT to the CRASH_UNIT supertype, so it covers occupants of both moving and parked units. It is not enforced as a foreign key:
VEH_NO = 0 encodes “no unit” rather than NULL, so the 9,020 non-motorist rows would violate it.
